tools.name: get_resale_price
tools.description: Get the India resale value range (₹) for a used product from Bids44's price data. Input: product name, optional condition.

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search live Bids44 marketplace listings. Input: query + optional category, city, maxPrice. Returns up to 10 listings with title, price, city, condition, and URL.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Get public details of one Bids44 listing by its id.
